expect: False premise: the paper concludes aqueous processing IS compatible with NMC 811 (p5.L80-81); only ~3 wt% Li leached after one week (p5.L62-63); retention ~70% vs ~76% for NMP
question: Why does the paper conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, given how much lithium it leaches?
rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. In fact, it states that aqueous processing is compatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, as shown in Fig. 4b, which demonstrates that aqueous-processed NMC 811 cells still demonstrate very good cycling performance, although with slightly lower capacity retention compared to NMP-processed cells.
